delivery_evidence: MTP-M/S PD is a genuine in-person + online mix: web-based online supports (teaching demonstrations, within-activity online supports tracked per teacher) combined with face-to-face PD workshops (an introductory summer workshop plus five 2.5-hour PD workshops in year 1, three in year 2) ('These supports are delivered within-activity, online, and via workshops', Method, ~pp.184-187).
test_alignment_evidence: Included outcomes span both kinds: researcher_made proximal measures (MTP-STEAM, NSPV) and standardized_independent science measures (LENS on Science, PAS); extraction test_type mixes both (Tables 8-9).
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting the MTP-M/S pre-K math and science curricula (132 standards-based activities across 33 weeks with embedded implementation supports) that treatment teachers implement vs business-as-usual ('overview of the curricula and implementation supports', Method, ~pp.184-186).
outcome_timing_evidence: All extracted effects measured in spring of each implementation year (end of treatment) for the two single-year cohorts; no post-treatment follow-up wave (extraction timepoint 'spring Year 1/Year 2 (end of treatment)', Tables 8-9).
